snippet.title: SMUSH.TV - Competitive VR x PC Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Available Now on Steam with a 15% Launch Discount!

Steam Store Page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/912920/SMUSHTV__Competitive_VR_x_PC_Action/

Join the community at: https://www.discord.gg/nBJdWqW

SMUSH.TV is the first hyper-competitive PC vs VR action-strategy game. It brings the spirit of competitive fighting games into VR through fast heart-thumping gameplay. It is currently local multiplayer and works great with Steam Remote Play Anywhere.

Play on PC and drop blocks to SMUSH the VR player. Play in VR to dodge blocks and get to the top of the grid! Outsmart and outplay your opponent using an arsenal of active skills with 16 possible combinations per player.
